apps.name: LocalSend
apps.tagline: Share files securely with nearby devices over local Wi-Fi.
apps.description: A fast, open-source cross-platform tool for transferring photos, documents, and folders across Android, Windows, macOS, and Linux without internet or cloud accounts.
highlights: Direct peer-to-peer local network transfers with HTTPS encryption
No account creation, trackers, or external cloud servers required
Native builds available for Android, Windows, macOS, and Linux

apps.name: Flow Launcher
apps.tagline: Instant keyboard-driven launcher and file search for Windows.
apps.description: Launch apps, locate deep system files, run web queries, and automate daily developer tasks in milliseconds from a single minimal command bar.
highlights: Sub-millisecond fuzzy search across local files and installed apps
Extensible plugin ecosystem for clipboard, calculator, and web tools
Lightweight native footprint designed for distraction-free focus

apps.name: Draw.io Desktop
apps.tagline: Offline diagramming, architecture flows, and clean wireframes.
apps.description: Create system architecture diagrams, ER models, flowcharts, and clean UI sketches completely offline with local file privacy and crisp vector exports.
highlights: 100% offline local storage with zero telemetry or cloud lock-in
Export crisp SVG, PNG, and PDF files for documentation and slides
Rich library of architecture, network, and wireframe stencils

apps.name: Ente Auth
apps.tagline: End-to-end encrypted two-factor authenticator for every device.
apps.description: Keep your 2FA codes safely backed up with zero-knowledge encryption, instant search, offline support, and clean cross-device sync.
highlights: Audited end-to-end encryption with offline-first code generation
One-tap copy with clean next-code preview and smart tagging
Open-source releases published directly through GitHub Releases
